select tmp.acctSubjectType, tmp.portfolioId , tmp.portfolioName, tmp.finprodId, tmp.prodId, tmp.channelId, tmp.channelName, tmp.payType, #{taxClass} taxClass, to_char(max(tmp.mdate),'yyyy-mm-dd') taxStartDate, sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{TAX0102} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) interestIncome, /*利息收入*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{TAX0202} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) dividendIncome, /*红利收入*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{TAX0302} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) difbetIncome, /*价差收入*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0102} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) constructionTax, /*城建税*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0202} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) educationTax, /*教育费*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0302} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) placeeducationTax, /*地方教育费*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0402} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) waterTrafficTax, /*水利基金税*/ sum(tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp) taxTotal, /*税费总额*/ to_char(#{payment1}, 'YYYY') || '年' || trunc((to_char(#{payment1}, 'MM') + 2) / 3) || '季度销项税金结转金额:' || to_char(sum(tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp), 'fm999990.9999') remark /*交易备注*/ from ( select case when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F18} then ptl.portfolio_id when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F16} then ad.portfolio_id end portfolioId, case when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F18} then ptl.portfolio_name when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F16} then (select ptl1.portfolio_name from ptl_portfolio ptl1 where ad.portfolio_id = ptl1.portfolio_id) end portfolioName, ptl.profit_type, bok.acct_subject_type acctSubjectType, fee.finprod_id finprodId, bok.acct_subject_id prodId, fin1.finprod_market_id channelId, fin1.finprod_abbr channelName, ad1.pay_type payType, nvl(deal.mdate + 1,fin.vdate) mdate, fee.fee_type, fee.branch, fee.tdy_unpaid_intincexp
from bok_position_prdfee fee left join bok_bookset bok on fee.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id left join ptl_portfolio ptl on ptl.portfolio_id = fee.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fin on fin.finprod_id = fee.finprod_id left join fin_product_add ad on fee.finprod_id = ad.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fin1 on fin1.finprod_id = fee.chl_id left join fin_product_add ad1 on fin1.finprod_id = ad1.finprod_id left join trd_product_deal deal on deal.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id and deal.chl_id = fee.chl_id and deal.busi_type = #{BUSI_TYPE_16} and deal.ps = #{taxidenType} and deal.trade_status = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} and deal.is_cancel = #{YES_NO_NO} and deal.mdate <= #{payment1} where 1=1 and fee.CDATE <= #{payment1} AND ((SELECT MDATE FROM trd_product_deal deal1 WHERE deal1.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id AND deal1.chl_id = fee.chl_id AND deal1.busi_type = #{BUSI_TYPE_16} AND deal1.ps = #{taxidenType} AND deal1.trade_status = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND deal1.is_cancel = #{YES_NO_NO}) is null or (SELECT MDATE FROM trd_product_deal deal1 WHERE deal1.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id AND deal1.chl_id = fee.chl_id AND deal1.busi_type = #{BUSI_TYPE_16} AND deal1.ps = #{taxidenType} AND deal1.trade_status = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND deal1.is_cancel = #{YES_NO_NO}) >= #{payment1}) and fin1.finprod_market_id = #{channelId} and fee.tdy_unpaid_intincexp != 0 and fee.fee_type in (#{TAX0102},#{TAX0202},#{TAX0302},#{ALT0102},#{ALT0202},#{ALT0302},#{ALT0402}) and not exists ( select * from trd_product_deal deal1 where deal1.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id and deal1.chl_id = fee.chl_id and deal1.busi_type = #{BUSI_TYPE_16} and deal1.ps = #{taxidenType} and deal1.trade_status = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} and deal1.is_cancel = #{YES_NO_NO} and deal1.mdate = #{payment1} ) ) tmp group by portfolioId,portfolioName,finprodId,prodId,channelId, channelName,payType,acctSubjectType
